collection.credit:
NEW EVENTS — HUMOR AND ABSURDITY (HUM-01 to HUM-50, draft for the owner, 2026-11-15)
Slapstick, silly noises, puns, pranks with permission, ridiculous coincidences, a little funny magic and animals being absurd. Nobody is the butt of the joke: everyone keeps their dignity, and the comedy needs no victim.
Written in the style of the owner's own events. Edit anything and send it back; nothing ships until you approve.

ledger.why: the casting line, carried out as the roles' ages (picks two adults)

collection.description: A villager who rolled about asleep on the beach finds sand everywhere: go for a swim, or accept the sand.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: Yesterday afternoon, (subject) fell asleep on the beach and rolled over several times. Today there is sand everywhere. In (subject.his/her) hair. In (subject.his/her) ears. In (subject.his/her) breakfast, somehow. Every time (subject.he/she) thinks it's gone, more appears from places (subject.he/she) didn't know could hold sand.

o2.name: Outcome B
o2.text: (subject) gives up and lets the sand be. It trickles out of (subject.his/her) clothes every time (subject.he/she) sits down, leaving little piles all over the village, and (friend) finds (subject.him/her) for lunch simply by following the trail. Days later, (subject) discovers one last grain in (subject.his/her) eyebrow. (subject.He/she) considers keeping it, as a souvenir.

o1__fx.name: Outcome A
o1__fx.text: (subject) marches into the sea and washes every last grain away. It feels wonderful. (subject.He/she) comes out, lies down on the warm beach to dry, and falls fast asleep. When (friend) finds (subject.him/her) an hour later, (subject.he/she) is covered in sand again, from head to foot, and smiling in (subject.his/her) sleep.
